channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Spain bans flavours for e-cigarettes and white snus – Artificial tobacco only flavour allowed
item.description: Spain has approved new restrictions on smoke-free nicotine products, permitting only artificial tobacco flavours in e-cigarettes and nicotine pouches, alongside a maximum nicotine content of 4mg per pouch. (Published on November 26, 2026byvejpkollen.se)

item.title: Kenya Should Not Jail Adults for Using Nicotine Pouches
item.description: Kenya is considering legislation that could impose up to ten years in prison or a KSh 5 million fine for using nicotine pouches, while conventional cigarettes would remain legally available. (Published on November 26, 2026bycenterforglobalhealthaccountability.org)

item.title: Bangladesh Smokeless Tobacco: The Oral Cancer Crisis
item.description: Around 22 million adults in Bangladesh use traditional smokeless tobacco products such as zarda, gul and sadapata, with use particularly prevalent among women. (Published on November 26, 2026bytobaccoharmreduction.net)
